color.doc: Fallback used for 'color1'/'color2' when they aren't set individually. Defaults to white if this is also unset.

color1.doc: First color. Falls back to 'color', then white, if unset.

color2.doc: Second color, used for the two-color variant. Falls back to 'color', then white, if unset.

colorOct.doc: Octaves for the color-selection noise, used for the two-color variant.

colorPersistence.doc: Persistence for the color-selection noise, used for the two-color variant.

colorScale.doc: Scale for the color-selection noise, used for the two-color variant.

colorThreshold.doc: Noise threshold above which 'color2' is used instead of 'color1'.
